mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP indicates strong economic activity, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production suggests increased economic output, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If industrial production growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If unemployment rate decreases but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When both unemployment rate decreases and employment increases, it signals a strong economy, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If both proxies improve but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is low but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates strong demand in the housing market, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If housing starts increase but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation rises but federal funds rate does not adjust, it may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days due to monetary policy uncertainty.
failure_condition: If inflation rises without corresponding rate changes but S&P 500 returns are positive more than 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-interest-rate regime, GDP growth signals strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDP grows in a low-rate regime but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time.
